sections.MESSAGE_TO_USER:
mboetger left three inline comments on [#196561](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561) a few minutes before he approved it. He is a human reviewer, so I won't post any replies. I'll draft them here for you to post.

**Comment 1:** "nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists" ([r4606831206](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206))
- His point holds. It is a style change only, and on its own it isn't worth dismissing three approvals and rerunning about an hour of presubmits.
- I've asked matt561 to prepare it as a local commit and not push it. It gets pushed only if we push something else anyway.

**Comments 2 and 3:** one thread on the `errorMessage` KDoc ([r4606860038](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038))
- The KDoc says that with `force-version-code-ignoring-abi`, APKs with no `versionCode` "Android refuses to install."
- mboetger says he installed such an APK with adb. Only Play upload fails. He thinks installing fails only when a build with a `versionCode` is already on the device.
- This is a claim about behavior, so I'm not calling it a wording nit yet. matt561 is reproducing it now on an emulator. I've also asked them to check the other claim in that KDoc: that AGP fails the build when the value is not a decimal integer.
- If he is right, the KDoc is wrong. Also, the reason we give for leaving the flag out of the error message is wrong. The message is what users see, and it is what you would cherry-pick. So I'd want to fix it here, not in a follow-up that needs its own 3.50 and 3.51 cherry-picks.

**Decision: merge now, or wait for the reproduction?**
- **1a (recommended): hold the merge until the reproduction reports back.** That should take less than an hour.
  - If only the KDoc is wrong and the message is fine: merge as is. Fix the KDoc and the nit in a follow-up on main only. That follow-up changes only an internal comment and code style, so it needs no cherry-pick.
  - If the message should change, for example to suggest the flag for fresh installs: push the fix plus the nit in one commit. You'd then need to re-approve, ask bkonyi and mboetger to re-approve, and wait about an hour of CI before you cherry-pick.
- **1b: merge now and fix anything in a follow-up.** This lands fastest. The risk is that if the message is wrong, 3.50 and 3.51 ship the wrong guidance until a second cherry-pick lands in both.

Reply "go 1a" to hold, or "go 1b" to merge now.

Draft reply to comment 1, to post after we decide:
> Good call. Switched to `value.toBigIntegerOrNull()` [in this PR / in follow-up #___].

I'll draft the reply on the comment 2/3 thread once the reproduction results are in.
sections.WORKER_BRIEF:
<WORKER-BRIEF>

**Task:** for flutter/flutter#196561, branch `vcfix-manifest-fallback` on the `reidbaker-agent` fork, head `f3d2ab1fd3b`. Reproduce the reviewer's claim and prepare a fix locally.

**Do NOT push.** The PR has three approvals and green CI. Any push dismisses the approvals and reruns about an hour of presubmits. Commit locally only, and report back to me (the mayor). I'll decide whether and when to push.

**Do NOT reply on GitHub.** mboetger is a human reviewer. Draft any reply text in your report.

### Thread A: reproduce first
URL: https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606860038
File: `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt`, line 152.

mboetger's comments, verbatim:
> I don't think this is true.  Can't submit to Play Store sure - but I was able to install with adb.

> I believe it will reject if you try to install over a build with a versionCode.

The code under the thread:
```kotlin
/**
 * Formats the `--split-per-abi` error for [variantName] when `android {}` omits `versionCode`
 * and reading the main manifest fails ([reason]).
 *
 * Does not suggest `force-version-code-ignoring-abi`, because it cannot help here. When the
 * manifest has no positive `versionCode`, the flag builds APKs with no `versionCode`, which
 * Android refuses to install. When the value is not a decimal integer, AGP fails the build.
 */
internal fun errorMessage(variantName: String, reason: String): String = ...
```

Status of the claims: none of them are reproduced yet. Not mboetger's, and not the two in the KDoc ("Android refuses to install" and "AGP fails the build"). Treat all of them as unverified until you run the steps below.

Steps:
1. Create a Flutter app whose `android {}` block omits `versionCode` and whose main `AndroidManifest.xml` has no `android:versionCode`.
2. Build with `flutter build apk --split-per-abi -P force-version-code-ignoring-abi=true`. Run `aapt2 dump badging` on the arm64 or x86_64 APK and record what `versionCode` it reports, if any.
3. On a fresh emulator with the app not installed, run `adb install <apk>`. Record the full output.
4. Uninstall. Install a build of the same app ID that has a positive `versionCode`. Then `adb install` the no-`versionCode` APK over it, with and without `-r`. Record the output.
5. Repeat step 2 with a manifest `versionCode` that is not a decimal integer, and with `0` or a negative value. Record whether AGP fails the build or the install fails.
6. Record the emulator API level, the AGP version and the Flutter revision you used.

Then tell me whether code, tests or docs must change, and why.
- Should the error message suggest the flag in some cases, for example fresh or debug installs?
- Or is only the KDoc wrong?

If something must change, commit it locally with matching test updates, and include the diff in your report. Don't decide alone to change the user-facing message without showing me the reproduction output.

### Thread B: nit, local commit only
URL: https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561#discussion_r4606831206
File: `ManifestVersionCodeTaskHelper.kt`, line 113.

mboetger's comment, verbatim:
> nit: toBigIntegerOrNull() exists

The code:
```kotlin
val versionCode =
    try {
        BigInteger(value)
    } catch (e: NumberFormatException) {
        null
    }
```

Check that `value.toBigIntegerOrNull()` (Kotlin stdlib) behaves the same for every input the existing tests cover, including empty, whitespace, signs and very long values. If it does, make the change as a separate local commit and run the Gradle plugin unit tests.

### Report back with
- Every command you ran and its output: the badging output, the `adb install` output, and the build failures.
- Your verdict on Thread A, with the reason.
- Local commit SHAs and diffs.
- Test results.
- Draft reply text for each thread, stating the change or proposal directly.
